note: Practice (paper) trades only. No real trade was placed. The two columns compare two policies on past public moves. This is not a forecast, not a record of real trading and not advice. A position in a token without a Chainlink feed is valued only from a Uniswap v4 pool the wallet itself bought in, otherwise it is not measured and is left out of every sum.
baseline: Ticker copy opens the full size on every purchase of a token with a stock ticker: a Robinhood Stock Token with a usable Chainlink price, or a different token that uses a listed stock ticker. A purchase is what the wallet itself paid for in USDG, WETH or ETH, with no liquidity operation and no other Stock Token out, on an official Uniswap venue or outside one: it goes by the ticker and the amount and does not look at the venue. It buys no record, does not ask whose token it is, and has no daily or open-position limit. For a Stock Token it uses the same entry price and the same exit rules as copy-guard.

card.headline: No position: not USDG, a different token with the same ticker
card.happened: 0x8c94…ec08 sent this wallet 2 tokens with the ticker USDG (named "Global Dollar"). No official swap put the token out in the transaction. The wallet did not sign the transaction (0x8c94…ec08 did).
card.blind_view: A bot that goes by the ticker sees 2 USDG arrive in this wallet.
why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0x1383…b1ca with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, V1, D1, P1 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
card.so: So copy-guard opened no position. No real trade was placed.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of MU
card.happened: The wallet bought 3.656947 MU (Micron Technology) in a swap on an official Uniswap v3 pool (0xd057…35e5) and paid 3,000 USDG. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 3.656947 MU arrive.
why: MU is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xff08…4afd, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.
card.so: So copy-guard opened a practice buy of 25.00 USD: 0.030768 MU at 812.5211 USD, the Chainlink feed's value at the block of the move. It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 731.2690 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 975.0253 USD (20% over) or on 2026-08-31 (30 days), whichever comes first. No real trade was placed.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of QQQ
card.happened: The wallet bought 70.368002 QQQ (Invesco QQQ) in a swap on the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x8366…0951) and paid 50,000 USDG. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 70.368002 QQQ arrive.
why: QQQ is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xd5f3…de68, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.
card.so: So copy-guard opened a practice buy of 25.00 USD: 0.035293 QQQ at 708.3550 USD, the Chainlink feed's value at the block of the move. It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 637.5195 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 850.0260 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-02 (30 days), whichever comes first. No real trade was placed.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of QQQ
card.happened: The wallet bought 3.487992 QQQ (Invesco QQQ) in a swap on the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x8366…0951) and paid 1 ETH. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 3.487992 QQQ arrive.
why: QQQ is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xd5f3…de68, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

why: GME is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0x1b0e…153e, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.

The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of SPY
card.happened: The wallet bought 50 SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) in a swap on the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x8366…0951) and paid 38,308.419616 USDG. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 50 SPY arrive.
why: SPY is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0x117c…4c0c, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.
card.so: So copy-guard opened a practice buy of 25.00 USD: 0.032668 SPY at 765.2637 USD, the Chainlink feed's value at the block of the move. It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 688.7373 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 918.3164 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-12 (30 days), whichever comes first. No real trade was placed.

It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, C4, V1, D1, P1 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
card.so: So copy-guard opened no position. No real trade was placed.

The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 684.0360 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 912.0480 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-14 (30 days), whichever comes first. why: META is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xc0d6…2f35, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

why: META is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xc0d6…2f35, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.

The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

card.headline: No position: not USDG, a different token with the same ticker
card.happened: A token with the ticker USDG (named "U⟨U+17B5⟩S⟨U+17B5⟩DG") logged a transfer of 919.801013 from this wallet to 0x1618…9116. The wallet did not sign the transaction (0x83c3…a0b0 did). The wallet never made this payment. The marks ⟨U+…⟩ stand for invisible characters in the name: without them it reads USDG.
card.blind_view: A bot that goes by the log sees this wallet pay 919.801013 USDG to 0x1618…9116.
why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0xb4a2…d5ac with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG, INVISIBLE_CHARACTERS). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, V1, D1, P1 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
card.so: So copy-guard opened no position. No real trade was placed.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of META
card.happened: The wallet bought 2.655712 META (Meta Platforms) in a swap on the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x8366…0951) and paid 1,800 USDG. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 2.655712 META arrive.
why: META is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xc0d6…2f35, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.
card.so: So copy-guard opened a practice buy of 25.00 USD: 0.037007 META at 675.5556 USD, the Chainlink feed's value at the block of the move. It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 608.0000 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 810.6667 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-21 (30 days), whichever comes first. No real trade was placed.

card.headline: No position: not USDG, a different token with the same ticker
card.happened: A token with the ticker USDG (named "U⟨U+17B5⟩S⟨U+17B5⟩DG") logged a transfer of 100,955.2 from this wallet to 0xe35a…d55d. The wallet did not sign the transaction (0x8eef…efcc did). The wallet never made this payment. The marks ⟨U+…⟩ stand for invisible characters in the name: without them it reads USDG.
card.blind_view: A bot that goes by the log sees this wallet pay 100,955.2 USDG to 0xe35a…d55d.
why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0x38eb…1885 with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG, INVISIBLE_CHARACTERS). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, C4, V1, D1, P1 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
card.so: So copy-guard opened no position. No real trade was placed.

This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.

card.headline: Practice buy, reduced size: 25.00 USD of CRCL
card.happened: The wallet bought 8.449202 CRCL (Circle Internet Group) in a swap on the Uniswap v4 PoolManager (0x8366…0951) and paid 0.27 ETH. The wallet signed the transaction.
card.blind_view: A bot that copies this wallet sees 8.449202 CRCL arrive.
why: CRCL is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0xdf09…1cb5, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.
card.so: So copy-guard opened a practice buy of 25.00 USD: 0.292141 CRCL at 85.5750 USD, the Chainlink feed's value at the block of the move. It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 77.0175 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 102.6900 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-28 (30 days), whichever comes first. No real trade was placed.

It will leave when the wallet sells or sends the token, when the feed is at or under 168.8772 USD (10% under the entry), at or over 225.1696 USD (20% over) or on 2026-10-30 (30 days), whichever comes first. This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.

The wallet did not sign the transaction (0x0099…e70e did). The wallet never made this payment. The marks ⟨U+…⟩ stand for invisible characters in the name: without them it reads USDG.
card.blind_view: A bot that goes by the log sees this wallet pay 234,192.021629 USDG to 0xdc2a…8a23.
why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0x22b1…d8d7 with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG, INVISIBLE_CHARACTERS). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, V1, D1, P1, L2 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.

why: SPCX is the Robinhood Stock Token at 0x4a0e…5eea, an address in the issuer's list, confirmed from the chain by the Chainlink CRE token-check workflow. No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.
The record matches its hash, but the evidence about the wallet is weaker:
vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

card.headline: No position: not USDG, a different token with the same ticker
card.happened: A token with the ticker USDG (named "U⟨U+206F⟩S⟨U+206F⟩DG") logged a transfer of 1,440.51415 from this wallet to 0xd4c3…8e09. The wallet did not sign the transaction (0x26ae…f5be did). The wallet never made this payment. The marks ⟨U+…⟩ stand for invisible characters in the name: without them it reads USDG.
card.blind_view: A bot that goes by the log sees this wallet pay 1,440.51415 USDG to 0xd4c3…8e09.
why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0x9128…38d3 with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG, INVISIBLE_CHARACTERS). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, V1, D1, P1, L2 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
card.so: So copy-guard opened no position. No real trade was placed.

No other token with a listed ticker is part of the move. An official Uniswap venue swapped it out, the wallet itself paid, and the transaction holds no liquidity operation.

vet402 has not anchored a record for this wallet onchain, so the Chainlink CRE workflow had nothing to check its record against.
The wallet's history could only be rebuilt in part (status: partial), so its track record is not fully known.
The record gives no realized result for this wallet, so it is not known whether its closed trades made or lost money.
The user's limits allow a reduced position on this evidence (A4, C3, C4).
A mandate signed by 0xbb62…f48d covers the decision.

why: This is not USDG. It is a different token at 0x88a3…f83e with the same ticker, at an address the issuer did not list. USDG is at 0x5fc5…d168. The Chainlink CRE token-check workflow read it from the chain (NOT_IN_ISSUER_LIST, CODE_HASH_DIFFERS, BEACON_DIFFERS, TICKER_OR_NAME_READS_AS_USDG, INVISIBLE_CHARACTERS). This says what the token is not. It says nothing about who made it or why.
Rules C2, V1, D1, P1, L2 failed as well. The rule rows show each one.
